The first member by\n/// insertion order becomes the current actor at turn number 1.\npub fn start_campaign(campaign_id: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?
